rows.description: City Commission: Res 2024-R-17 amends FY2023-24 budget by $20,359,097 for police HQ design, public art projects, EOC, capital contribution to West Villages Improvement District, Morgan Center reroof and two tire balancers. Result: Pass per clerk.

City Council: Ord 2026-0572-E appropriates $33,958,000 from General Fund fund balance to a JXSF Completion Grant/Forgivable Loan contingency account to fund unfunded non-recurring future obligations. Result: Pass per clerk.
rows.shortfall: Jacksonville CAO (Nov 9): $150M to almost $200M less next budget; $300M by FY2028-29; library hours may shrink.

rows.description: City Council: Ord 2023-0876 appropriates $22,000,000 for a City Participation Loan and replenishment guaranty for Laura Trio, LLC, renovation of Laura Street Trio buildings plus two new towers (140+ hotel rooms, 165+ apartments). Outcome not verified.
